<script>
(function(){
var P=5990;
var PK=[[0,30,34,1.2],[870,64,42,1],[1670,130,42,1],[2530,205,50,1],[3400,272,100,1],[4270,276,96,1],[5070,210,45,1],[5930,122,42,1],[5990,116,42,1]];
var TK=[[0,-6,-27,54,-64,112,28,126,-54,133,0,0,15,94,66,16],
[870,-3,-34,48,-50,118,52,128,-34,148,1,1,15,93,134,168],
[1670,-5,-35,55,-52,122,52,128,-35,153,1,1,-25,93,134,168],
[2530,-5,5,52,-52,120,50,130,-20,150,1,1,-30,100,120,130],
[3900,-5,5,52,-52,120,50,130,-20,150,1,1,-30,100,120,130]];
var SK=[[3900,16,0,4],[4270,18,0,4],[4900,20,1,4],[5070,20,1,4],[5930,12,1,10],[5990,12,1,10]];
function ip(k,t){
  var n=k.length,i,j,a,b,u,r;
  if(t<=k[0][0])return k[0];
  for(i=1;i<n;i++){
    if(t<=k[i][0]){
      a=k[i-1];b=k[i];u=(t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);r=[t];
      for(j=1;j<a.length;j++)r.push(a[j]+(b[j]-a[j])*u);
      return r;
    }
  }
  return k[n-1];
}
function f(v){return v.toFixed(2);}
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id);}
var ch=$('character-yellow-blob'),pt=$('pose-think'),ps=$('pose-salute'),belly=$('blob-belly');
var tf=$('think-face'),ter=$('think-eye-right'),tcO=$('tcO'),tcI=$('tcI'),thc=$('think-hand-cross');
var thO=$('thO'),thI=$('thI'),tch=$('think-hand-chin'),tchE=$('tchE');
var sf=$('salute-face'),saO=$('saO'),saI=$('saI'),sh=$('salute-hand');
function render(t){
  t=((t%P)+P)%P;
  var p=ip(PK,t);
  ch.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(p[1])+' '+f(p[2])+') scale('+f(p[3])+')');
  if(t<3835){
    pt.setAttribute('display','inline');ps.setAttribute('display','none');
    var k=ip(TK,t);
    tf.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(k[1])+' 0)');
    ter.setAttribute('opacity',f(k[10]));
    var d='M'+f(k[6])+' '+f(k[7])+' Q'+f((k[6]+k[8])/2)+' '+f((k[7]+k[9])/2+5)+' '+f(k[8])+' '+f(k[9]);
    tcO.setAttribute('d',d);tcI.setAttribute('d',d);
    thc.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(k[8])+' '+f(k[9])+')');
    var d2='M-44 84 L'+f(k[4])+' '+f(k[5])+' L'+f(k[2])+' '+f(k[3]);
    thO.setAttribute('d',d2);thI.setAttribute('d',d2);
    tch.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(k[2])+' '+f(k[3])+')');
    tchE.setAttribute('fill','rgb('+Math.round(k[13])+','+Math.round(k[14])+','+Math.round(k[15])+')');
    belly.setAttribute('cx',f(k[12]));belly.setAttribute('cy','185');
    belly.setAttribute('rx','40');belly.setAttribute('ry','48');
    belly.setAttribute('opacity',f(k[11]));
  }else{
    pt.setAttribute('display','none');ps.setAttribute('display','inline');
    var s=ip(SK,t),r=s[2];
    sf.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(s[1])+' 0)');
    var ex=-60+(-88+60)*r,ey=118+(50-118)*r,hx=-52+(-46+52)*r,hy=150+(s[3]-150)*r,an=95+(-3-95)*r;
    var d3='M-44 84 L'+f(ex)+' '+f(ey)+' L'+f(hx)+' '+f(hy);
    saO.setAttribute('d',d3);saI.setAttribute('d',d3);
    sh.setAttribute('transform','translate('+f(hx)+' '+f(hy)+') rotate('+f(an)+')');
    belly.setAttribute('cx','12');belly.setAttribute('cy','155');
    belly.setAttribute('rx','44');belly.setAttribute('ry','75');
    belly.setAttribute('opacity','1');
  }
}
window.nwb={render:render};
render(0);
})();
</script>
